pick.description: Which candidates: all of them; the highest by the ranking (a number, a share, or all those at or above a threshold; when none reaches it, the step is skipped); the routers with the largest subtree or the most children; drawn at random; the lowest IDs

x-default.text: the highest when a ranking is given, else all

x-enum-titles.above: All at or above a threshold

fraction.title: Share
fraction.description: The share of the candidates: the highest ones by the ranking (at least one node), or drawn at random

value.title: Threshold
value.description: The ranking value a node must reach, in the unit of the ranking

allOf.x-message: Choose the earlier step whose nodes are meant
Picking the highest needs a ranking (rank by)
Picking the highest share needs a ranking (rank by) and the share
Picking those at or above a threshold needs a ranking (rank by) and the threshold
Give the node ID
Give the node IDs

Give the node and the hop count
Give the storey
Give the area
Give the label
Give the share

relative.title: Relative to
relative.description: A multiple of a metric measured in an earlier phase

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: The metric of the earlier phase (default: the condition's metric); a capacity search also gives its capacity (capacity_pps)

pdr.description: Delivery ratio of the flow: echoes received / requests sent; for multicast, receptions / (sends x members expected to receive)
pdr.per_node: the delivery ratio of the packets the router originated

rtt.mean_ms.per_node: the mean RTT of the packets the router originated

rtt.p95_ms.per_node: the 95th percentile RTT of the packets the router originated

rtt.max_ms.per_node: the maximum RTT of the packets the router originated

latency.mean_ms.description: Mean one-way delay (send to reception at the target)

offered_pps.description: Packets sent per second by the flow, measured over the whole network

delivered_pps.description: Packets delivered (echoed) per second, whole network

queue.mean_max.description: Highest mean queue depth of a node (MAC and adaptation layer) over the window
queue.mean_max.per_node: the router's mean queue depth (MAC and adaptation layer)

queue.now_max.description: Highest queue depth of a node at the end of the window

queue.drops.description: Packets dropped by full adaptation-layer queues (all nodes) in the window
queue.drops.per_node: the packets the router's full queue dropped

mac.retries_per_frame.description: MAC retries per unicast frame delivered, whole network
mac.retries_per_frame.per_node: the router's MAC retries per unicast frame delivered

mac.give_up.description: Unicast frames the MAC gave up (no ACK, channel access, other), all nodes, in the window
mac.give_up.per_node: the unicast frames the router's MAC gave up

mac.cca_fail_rate.description: Channel-access failures / CCA attempts, whole network

mesh.joined_fraction.description: Routers with a route to the border router (parent chain)

mesh.orphans.description: Running routers without a route to the border router

mesh.parent_changes.description: Parent changes in the window, all routers

power.avg_ma.description: Mean of the routers' average currents in the window (needs power recording)

medium.frames_per_s.description: Frames sent per second, whole network

medium.airtime_s_per_s.description: Total airtime of the frames sent, per second of the window (all nodes)

medium.loss_share.description: Share of the frames heard by listening receivers that were lost (central medium)

loss.description: Share of the application packets lost in the window (not delivered, or not echoed for an echoed flow): one minus the delivery ratio
loss.per_node: the share of the packets the router originated that were lost

mac.retries.description: MAC retransmissions of the unicast frames delivered in the window, all nodes
mac.retries.per_node: the MAC retransmissions of the router's unicast frames delivered

medium.collisions.description: Frames lost at a receiver because another frame or an external interferer overlapped them, all receivers, in the window
medium.collisions.per_node: the frame receptions lost to a collision at the router

medium.collision_share.description: Share of the frames heard by listening receivers that were lost to a collision
medium.collision_share.per_node: the frame receptions lost to a collision at the router over those it heard

queue.mean.title: Mean queue
queue.mean.description: Mean queue depth of the node (MAC plus adaptation layer) over the ranking window

queue.max.title: Queue peak
queue.max.description: Exact peak of the node's queue depth (MAC plus adaptation layer), reported at every report window: the ranking window may start up to one window early

rtt.mean_ms.title: Mean RTT
rtt.mean_ms.description: Mean round-trip time of the node's packets in the ranking window

rtt.max_ms.title: Maximum RTT
rtt.max_ms.description: Maximum round-trip time of the node's packets in the ranking window

mac.retries_per_frame.title: MAC retries per frame
mac.retries_per_frame.description: MAC retries per unicast frame the node delivered in the ranking window

mac.retries.title: MAC retries
mac.retries.description: MAC retransmissions of the unicast frames the node delivered in the ranking window

medium.collisions.title: Collisions
medium.collisions.description: Frames lost to a collision while the node was receiving, in the ranking window (another frame or an external interferer overlapping them)

loss.title: Loss
loss.description: Share of the node's packets lost in the ranking window (packets it sent, and for downlink traffic the packets sent to it)

subtree.title: Subtree size
subtree.description: Routers below the node in the routing tree when the step starts

children.title: Number of children
children.description: Routers whose preferred parent is the node when the step starts

t_start_s.title: Start
t_start_s.description: Start of the window or step (virtual time)

t_end_s.title: End
t_end_s.description: End of the window or step (virtual time)

t_mid_s.title: Time
t_mid_s.description: Middle of the window or step (virtual time)

step_index.title: Step
step_index.description: Index of the scenario step running; empty outside a step

offered_pps.title: Offered load
offered_pps.description: Packets sent per second by the main flow (up if running, else the first), whole network

delivered_pps.title: Delivered load
delivered_pps.description: Packets delivered (echoed) per second, main flow

pdr.title: Delivery ratio
pdr.description: Packets delivered (echoed) over packets sent, main flow

loss.title: Loss
loss.description: One minus the delivery ratio, main flow

rtt.p95_ms.title: RTT p95
rtt.p95_ms.description: 95th percentile of the round-trip time, main flow

latency.p95_ms.title: One-way delay p95
latency.p95_ms.description: 95th percentile of the one-way delay, main flow

mac.retries.title: MAC retries
mac.retries.description: MAC retransmissions of the unicast frames delivered, all nodes

mac.retries_per_frame.title: MAC retries per frame
mac.retries_per_frame.description: MAC retries per unicast frame delivered, all nodes

medium.collisions.title: Collisions
medium.collisions.description: Frames lost at a receiver to a collision, all receivers

medium.collision_share.title: Collision share
medium.collision_share.description: Receptions lost to a collision over frames heard

queue.mean_max.title: Highest mean queue depth
queue.mean_max.description: Highest mean queue depth of a node (MAC plus adaptation layer)

power.min_ma.title: Current min
power.min_ma.description: Lowest average current of a router (needs power recording)

power.mean_ma.title: Current mean
power.mean_ma.description: Mean of the routers' average currents (needs power recording)

power.max_ma.title: Current max
power.max_ma.description: Highest average current of a router (needs power recording)

power.max_node.title: Highest-current router
power.max_node.description: The router with the highest average current

power.br_ma.title: Border router current
power.br_ma.description: Average current of the border router (needs power recording)

mesh.joined_fraction.title: Joined routers
mesh.joined_fraction.description: Share of the running routers with a route to the border router at the end of the window or step
